about.title: Solid engineering, clear communication
about.body: I'm Javier González, a software engineer specialised in backend and databases. I enjoy turning complex problems into functional, well-structured solutions while working remotely with clients.
about.body2: I focus on designing solid, secure and efficient systems, always thinking about the people who use them. I believe in quality, in continuous learning, in taking responsibility and in being honest. My work also covers architecture: shaping large systems so they are easy to maintain and grow.
about.quote: Clear deliverables, deadlines met and systems that can be maintained.

services.title: What I can do for your project
services.subtitle: Services focused on concrete results.

items.title: Software architecture
items.description: I design the structure of complex systems: well-separated modules and justified technical decisions, so your product can grow without becoming difficult to maintain.

items.title: Backend & APIs
items.description: I build tailored, secure, scalable REST services and APIs ready to integrate.

items.title: Databases
items.description: Relational and non-relational modelling, migrations and query optimisation so your product stays fast and stable as your data grows.

items.title: Fullstack projects
items.description: From database to interface, coordinating backend and frontend with React or Angular depending on what you need.

projects.title: Recent freelance work
projects.subtitle: A selection of fullstack and backend projects delivered for clients.

items.title: REST API for a client platform
items.description: Backend services to manage clients, roles and permissions with clear data models.
items.details: I designed entities, API contracts and validations. The delivery included basic tests and documentation for the client's team.

items.title: Database modelling and optimisation
items.description: Redesign of a relational schema and queries for a booking system.
items.details: I normalised tables, added indexes and reviewed critical queries. The result was lower latency and a model that's easier to maintain.

items.title: Fullstack dashboard implementation
items.description: Integration of a Node/TypeScript API with a React interface for daily operations.
items.details: I built the service, the data model and the interface. I coordinated contracts and loading states so the flow worked end to end.

items.title: Operational reporting platform: Rust + React
items.description: High-performance backend service for generating operational reports and metrics.
items.deliverable: Rust service, SQL queries, React interface, Docker image
items.details: I implemented the service in Rust, built the React interface, modelled the SQL queries and prepared it to run in containers.
